answer: One concrete mechanism: require each agent to stake a small bond and attach every registration to a verified peer vouching chain, where vouching peers must lock an equal bond. A sybil attacker must buy real stake for each fake identity plus collateral from distinct, already-trusted peers, multiplying cost per identity. Peers whisper a reputation signal weighted by their own history; any attempt to mirror a genuine agent's profile triggers a challenge.
